discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
rationale: Recent prizes have rotated through AI (2024) and superconducting quantum circuits (2025). Condensed-matter topology beyond the 2016 prize is a long-standing front-runner: Kane and Mele's Z2 theory and the Molenkamp group's HgTe quantum-well experiment founded a major field. The prize has stayed open since Shoucheng Zhang's death, and all three have won the Breakthrough, Dirac and Buckley prizes.
